text:
maria: Heads-up — a couple of customers hit a runtime error after the recent embed framing change. Their SDKs send a metadata frame with key 'meta-v2' and our workers expect 'x-meta'. Can we decide where to put a temporary shim?
jon: Do we have a repro payload?
alex: I have one from acme-prod. FWIW it's just a small header rename in the stream envelope, not the token bytes.
maria: Repro attached (sanitized). This is higher risk for low-latency apps — every extra parse hurts.
ryan: Quick options: 1) ingress router (edge) translates frames to x-meta; 2) runtime worker accepts both keys; 3) a sidecar that normalizes frames per-tenant. Tradeoffs: edge = cheapest for workers but adds compute in routers; worker = simplest code change but touches hot path; sidecar = operational overhead.
sara: We should also consider Dedicated customers who pin kernel/quantization - sidecar might be easier for private deployments.
jon: For hosted tenants, edge shim seems reasonable as temporary. We can flag per-tenant via feature flag in routing table and enable for affected customers only.
alex: Concern: edge translation would need to parse streaming frames enough to find meta keys. That will add ~200us p99 for short responses based on my microbenchmarks. Does that break our 50ms SLO for chat?
ryan: If we gate it per-tenant, p99 impact is limited to opt-ins. Also we can implement lazy parse: only inspect frames that contain a header byte pattern.
sara: Sidecar approach keeps runtime unchanged but requires onboarding for Private customers. Ops effort non-trivial.
ci-bot: deploy-check: ensure routing table config supports per-tenant boolean flags; rollouts must be canaryed at 1%, 10%, 50%, 100% with 24h observation windows.
maria: Proposal: implement fast, pattern-matching translation in ingress as short-lived shim, behind a per-tenant flag. Parallel work: add runtime acceptance for both keys (non-invasive) as permanent compatibility.
jon: Agree with two-stage. Edge shim for immediate mitigation, runtime acceptance as long-term. Need telemetry events: shim_applied=true, shim_latency_ms, tenant_flag_source.
alex: I'll draft the minimal translation code. Pseudocode: 
```
// in router frame handler
if (frame.hasRawHeaderPattern()) {
  if (frame.headers.contains("meta-v2")) {
    frame.headers.set("x-meta", frame.headers.get("meta-v2"));
    frame.headers.remove("meta-v2");
  }
}
```
ryan: Add unit tests for streaming frames + property-based fuzzing for malformed frames. Alert on any frame parsing errors > 0.1% in canary.
sara: For Dedicated/private: create sidecar template in infra repo and include migration docs for customer engineers.
maria: Action items: alex -> edge shim PR w/ lazy pattern match; jon -> routing flag + deploy plan + canary schedule; ryan -> runtime patch spec to accept dual keys; sara -> sidecar template and doc.
ci-bot: ticket created: #INFRA-4821 (edge shim) #RUNTIME-923 (dual-key acceptance) #OPS-312 (canary plan).
maria: timeline: edge shim + canary today (small cohort), runtime patch next week, sidecar templates in 2 weeks. Notify CSMs for affected tenants. :eyes:
